| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |

| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |

You can buy from **either - there is no advantage to one over the other** based on the information on those two listing pages. Price, shipping speed/cost, return policy, warranty, and customer rating are all identical.
